issue.title: [リサーチ] AIっぽさを出さない画像生成のやり方（2026-11-03）

normal_prompt:
Create a new refined NORMAL sprite of adult Tsumugi, carefully based on reference1 APPROVED E1. ROLE1 reference1: sole character identity, face/eyes/brown bob, body roundness, exact simplified floral muted purple hoodie, black pleated skirt/knee socks/chunky shoes, crossed arms holding tablet, colors and pose, no earrings. Preserve E1 recognizable restrained slightly melancholic normal face and soft unobtrusive brows hidden under bangs. Tablet back has SAME tiny camera upper-right and ONE modest medium-contrast warm-grey diagonal scratch upper-left; no extra scuffs/stickers/logos. ROLE2 reference2 Mashiro is ONLY petite head-body proportion target; DO NOT copy her face, hair, body shape, dress or palette. ROLE3 reference3 Minto and ROLE4 reference4 Ageha are ONLY linework and cel-shadow treatment; DO NOT copy their costumes, accessories, face, pose, hair or colors. Preserve original E1 pose, no forced asymmetry or added wear, no neck change or skinny body. Tsumugi is petite: target around 5.5 to 5.8 heads within5.4–6.2, maintain rounded compact body and recognizable face. Height optionB is a LATER runtime display scale0.90, do NOT stretch legs or move feet to simulate it in artwork. Full body with head/feet fully inside 1024x1536 portrait canvas, figure at least1300px high, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha-zero background; no background haze or shadows on background. STYLE STANDARD (shisha-game cast): draw this character in the same artist's hand as the approved Minto, Ageha and Rio sprites. Japanese 2D visual-novel game art; confident dark outlines, slightly heavier on the outer silhouette and thinner inside; flat local colors with two to three clearly shaped cel-shadow steps; highlights only as a few deliberate bands on the hair and small catchlights in the eyes. No skin gloss, no airbrush gradients, no rim light or glow, no photographic texture, no pore or fabric micro-detail, no dense ornamental noise, no hundreds of thin hair strands. Limited palette: hair and skin plus three or four main colors. Keep this character's own eye, brow, nose and mouth shapes and natural age and gender differences; do not drift toward a generic AI pretty face.
HEAD-TO-BODY STANDARD: the head from the top of the hair (not counting hats, hoods or ornaments) to the chin must be about one seventh of the full height from the top of the hair to the shoe soles (about 7 heads tall). For the petite cast (Tsumugi, Mashiro, Ageha, Same-chan) it is about 5.8 heads tall instead.
